== Introduction ==
After [[Duelmania 4]] there were national duelmania tournaments held in 11 different countries. The best players of those were invited to [[Duelmania True Masters]]. Missing the winner of DuelMania 4, [[Reppie]] because he went inactive halfway the national season, several other top players from earlier duelmania seasons were not attending the True Masters version because they did not compete in the national tournaments. Nonetheless the lineup wasn't less impressive than before. 

There were 32 players invited for a single elimination tournament.

* Running date: 2nd of December [[2004]] - 4th of Januari [[2005]]
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/ownage.qw #duelmania] ([[QuakeNet]])
* Website: [http://web.archive.org/web/20050404213746/duelmania.quakeworld.nu/?sec=true Duelmania TM] site on webarchive

== Settings, Rules, Maps ==
* Maps allowed: [[dm2]], [[dm4]], [[dm6]], [[aerowalk]], [[ztndm3]]
* Allowed clients: [[MQWCL]] 0.96 and [[FuhQuake]] with -ruleset smackdown
* Time limit: 10 minutes
* Overtime 3 minutes
* Deathmatch mode 3
* No Powerups
* No fairpacks
* Discharges enabled
